text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: We are here again this year at the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Who will come out on top of this year's Triple Crown tour?

text_block_list.name: Excited Spectator
text_block_list.text: It's gotta be Special Week! There's no way she can lose!

text_block_list.name: Fidgety Spectator
text_block_list.text: You really think so? I have high hopes for Seiun Sky.

text_block_list.name: Fidgety Spectator
text_block_list.text: Ohhh… But who would actually win? Hmmm, considering the distance…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Everyone's betting on those two, even though I'm the star here.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'm not giving up this victory, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: As a first-rate Umamusume, I will certainly be victorious in this year's Classics.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I know. But I won't let my guard down until I've left everyone in the dust and the race is over.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: …Well, it's time. I'll see you afterwards.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You know where to catch me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'll meet you in the winner's circle.
